description: This PHP source file defines a utility class 'OX_Admin_UI_Install_InstallUtils' for the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for session management, database and table support detection, folder permission checks, plugin verification and import, and message processing during upgrade procedures.

classes.name: OX_Admin_UI_Install_InstallUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for installation and upgrade support in the Revive Adserver project.

methods.name: getSessionStorage
methods.description: Returns session storage object associated with the installer session ID.

methods.name: getSupportedDbTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of supported database types based on loaded PHP extensions.

methods.name: getSupportedTableTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of supported table storage engines.

methods.name: checkFolderPermissions
methods.description: Checks if a specified folder exists and is writable.

methods.name: hasZoneError
methods.description: Checks if the database schema has timezone-related issues based on upgrade status.

methods.name: checkPluginsVerified
methods.description: Verifies plugin paths and returns verification status and path.

methods.name: importPlugins
methods.description: Imports plugins and related data from a previous installation path.

methods.name: getMessagesWithType
methods.description: Processes upgrade messages, categorizing them as errors, warnings, or info based on prefixes.
